name: recovery
summary: Threads that stop on a usage limit or a provider outage continue once the provider answers again, and fleet providers says which provider has capacity.
day: A thread that hits your plan's usage limit or a provider outage at night goes on by itself once your provider has capacity again, and a thread that keeps failing reaches you as one alert thread.
cost: While a thread waits on a limit or an outage, Fleet sends one small request per provider through the hub's proxy, at most every five minutes.
risk: Fleet sends continue messages to stopped threads without you in the room.

workflows.name: Provider recovery
workflows.sentence: Threads that stop on a usage limit or a provider outage continue by themselves once the provider answers again.
